The PFO units have fulham workhorse ballasts in them. Very hard on the bulbs expect to replace the bulbs every 6 months. If you buy the PFO your just paying extra for the enclosure. The ARO is definately not a Icecap. Straight from hellolights themselves recommend to replace the bulbs every 6 months.
